role: independent reproductive-performance replication of the history-dependent redistribution result
question: Does colony reproductive performance measured from independently monitored nests predict later within-island breeder redistribution in the same direction as the chick-count performance state?

nest_endpoint.eligible_nest: A unique studyName + Island + raw Colony + Site Number + Nest Number row with at least one nonmissing Egg 1 Lay Date or Egg 2 Lay Date.
nest_endpoint.primary_success: 1 if Chick 1 Creche Date or Chick 2 Creche Date is nonmissing, otherwise 0.
nest_endpoint.duplicate_rule: Fail closed on duplicate eligible nest keys; do not average or select duplicate nest histories.
nest_endpoint.date_values_role: Only missing versus nonmissing status is used for the primary endpoint; actual lay, hatch, loss or creche dates are not used.

colony_performance_state.island_season_eligibility: At least 3 colony codes with >=5 eligible monitored nests.
colony_performance_state.pooled_expectation: Within each island-season, pooled nest-success probability p = total successful monitored nests / total eligible monitored nests.
colony_performance_state.standardization: Within each eligible island-season, z-standardize colony Pearson residuals; call this R_i,t.
colony_performance_state.interpretation: R_i,t is relative monitored-nest reproductive performance independent of the chick-count numerator/denominator used in the earlier performance definition.

redistribution_outcome.inheritance: Exactly the lag-2 outcome definition used in PALMER_PERFORMANCE_REDISTRIBUTION_LAGS_V2.
redistribution_outcome.definition: For performance season t, outcome is colony relative growth during t+1 -> t+2: log1p(N_i,t+2)-log1p(N_i,t+1), demeaned within island-transition.
redistribution_outcome.colony_identity: Use raw colony codes with exact matching only; no manual aggregation or crosswalk.

primary_model.formula: relative_growth_i,t+1 = beta_repro * R_i,t + gamma * z_prior_size_i,t+1 + island:colony_code fixed effect + error.

inference.null: Within each predictor island-season, R_i,t is exchangeable among eligible colonies with respect to the frozen future redistribution outcome.
inference.permutation: Permute R_i,t among all eligible colonies within predictor island-season while preserving future missingness, outcome values, prior size and colony identity.
inference.p_value: one-sided upper-tail Monte Carlo p with +1 correction

minimum_information.failure_rule: If any minimum is not met, STOP without fitting beta_repro and do not relax thresholds.

sensitivities.minimum_10_nests: Repeat the primary analysis requiring >=10 eligible monitored nests per colony-season.
sensitivities.hatch_success: Replace primary creche success with 1 if Chick 1 Hatch Date or Chick 2 Hatch Date is nonmissing.
sensitivities.leave_one_island_out: Report observed beta_repro after excluding each island in turn when estimable.

decision_rule.independent_replication_supported: Primary beta_repro > 0 and one-sided permutation p <= 0.05.
decision_rule.not_supported: Otherwise do not claim independent monitored-nest replication.
decision_rule.insufficient: If the frozen minimum-information gate fails, classify as not tested rather than negative.

interpretation_if_supported: A reproductive-performance signal measured from independent nest histories predicts later within-island redistribution, strengthening the claim that dynamic biological state rather than a specific chick-count construction carries temporal information.
claim_boundaries: This test does not identify public-information use, immigration, retention, prospecting or breeding dispersal.
Nest monitoring locations may reflect nonrandom sampling and are not a census of every nest.
A positive result would replicate the state-performance association, not prove that reproductive success causally drives movement.
Do not change the creche endpoint, 5-nest threshold, lag, controls, alpha or permutation scheme after REPRO values are opened.
Do not rescue a failed information gate with manual colony aggregation or relaxed minimum sample sizes.
